sentences.en: Her husband was an accountant who worked for the mob.
sentences.zh: 她丈夫是一名会计师，为黑帮工作。

sentences.en: Allan was lucky and passed the tax accountant examination.
sentences.zh: 艾伦很幸运，通过了税务会计师考试。

sentences.en: The company accountant was sent to jail for cooking the books.
sentences.zh: 公司的会计师因做假账被送进了监狱。
